question: What form must be assigned to the heads of the corner peaks and the neck in this design?
premises: The preceding verse prescribes conceiving the same upper structure as spire and neck with a rounded appearance.
This verse extends that prescription to the heads of the corner peaks.
This verse also extends that prescription to the neck in the same manner.
inference: The heads of the corner peaks and the neck are to be conceived in the same manner as the previously described upper structure.
uncertainties: The exact architectural referent of karṇakūṭa in this context is not fully specified within the verse.
plain_english: In the same way, one should conceive the heads of the corner peaks and the neck.
